text:
payments-bot: Alert: charge failed for INV-4721 (Acme Corp) - decline code: expired_card. Attempt 1.

maria_finance: saw it. Acme is on annual billing, large payment. I pinged their billing contact earlier.

sam_support: they replied in support thread, card expired and they want to do a wire instead. Asked for wire instructions.

maria_finance: OK. We should give wire template and ask them to include invoice ref. Also disable auto-cancel and pause automated dunning for 48h. @julia_accounting can you hold dunning?

julia_accounting: will pause dunning 48h and mark invoice as "pending - customer wire". Please cc accounting when customer confirms.

raj_sales: FYI AM confirmed they can push the wire today if we send details. They asked if we can accept partial then reconcile; customer prefers full amount.

maria_finance: wire template (masking acct number):

```
Bank: First Example Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: ****6789
Routing/ABA: 111000025
SWIFT/BIC: EXAMPLExxx
Reference: INV-4721
Amount: USD 98,750.00
```

sam_support: sent template to customer @ 09:18 PT and asked them to reply once transfer initiated. I included link to PDF invoice: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-4721

maria_finance: scheduled one automatic retry for 20 hours from now in case they update card. If wire arrives first I'll cancel retry.

payments-bot: Retry scheduled for 1745318310 (20h).

julia_accounting: when wire lands paste bank confirmation here (txn id, amount). I'll reconcile and apply credit. If they ask for beneficiary verification, confirm company legal name and address: Redwood Inference, 123 Infra Rd, SF CA.

raj_sales: keeping loop open until cleared. If we don't get wire by EOD +2 escalate to collections. :thumbsup:
